subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch completes with replies=0 even though assistant final text is written to session transcript

question: Should Feishu recover a visible final reply from the current session transcript when shared dispatch returns no final payload, and if so under which source-delivery modes?
rationale: The code shows a plausible missing recovery path, but transcript-backed delivery changes privacy and duplicate-delivery behavior, so automation should not choose that policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix the shared reply boundary
options.body: Prefer identifying why `replyResult` is empty or suppressed and making the normal final payload deliver correctly before adding Feishu-specific transcript scraping.

options.title: Add a guarded Feishu transcript fallback
options.body: Allow Feishu to recover only same-turn, same-session final text after live proof and explicit checks for tool-only, silent, send-policy, and duplicate-delivery cases.

options.title: Treat this as configured privacy and improve diagnostics
options.body: If maintainers decide transcript finals must remain private in this mode, keep delivery behavior and improve logs/docs so operators can identify intentional suppression.

recommendation.title: Fix the shared reply boundary
recommendation.body: Prefer identifying why `replyResult` is empty or suppressed and making the normal final payload deliver correctly before adding Feishu-specific transcript scraping.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects Feishu channel behavior first, while the implementation may still need coordination with shared reply-routing owners.
